adjudicated_by: compliance-officer (independent fresh-agent re-derivation, no context from the original reporter's framing)
adjudication_rationale: The original finding's core comparison was factually wrong: the cited 'sibling reasons' (scope_empty/agent_ids_type/destructive_untargeted) are PRE-DISPATCH request-shape validation denials (400s, kTargetingShapeReasons/kRouteRejectReasons, a different metric family per dispatch_target_shape.hpp's own doc comment) fired BEFORE target resolution, not POST-DISPATCH outcome reasons like unknown_plugin (503s, fired inside the same sent==0 block as containment_unreadable/quarantined/generic-offline). The TRUE same-phase siblings are containment_unreadable and the generic offline catch-all -- both of which ALSO get zero audit rows in server.cpp's sent==0 block, pre-existing and unchanged by this PR. dispatch_target_shape.hpp's own in-tree doc comment (lines ~179-188) already states the unknown_plugin no-audit-row rationale. docs/user-manual/audit-log.md line 3 ('Yuzu records every operator action as a structured audit event') is opening framing prose, not a per-branch enumerated guarantee, and was already not literally true for containment_unreadable before this PR. No MUST/never/catastrophic-if-violated clause in CLAUDE.md, either routed-concerns file, or any accepted ADR requires an audit row for every dispatch-outcome branch -- no policy floor applies. Independently re-derived by a FRESH compliance-officer agent instance (no shared context with the original reporter or the orchestrating session's framing), given only the phase-distinction evidence and the containment_unreadable precedent, and asked explicitly to hold HIGH if the evidence did not change its mind. It did not hold HIGH; it landed at 'not HIGH/blocking... At most LOW/advisory' and found an even stronger precedent independently (the generic-offline branch also gets zero audit rows).
refuted_by: Direct trace of server.cpp's sent==0 block (all three REST-family routes) confirms containment_unreadable and the generic catch-all get NO audit_log call either -- only quarantined does, via separate pre-existing helpers called before response-building. Confirmed independently by a second, fresh compliance-officer instance.
refuted_by_reporter: compliance-officer (independent re-derivation instance, Gate 8 pass, not the original reporter)

DOWNGRADED after independent adjudication (see adjudication_rationale) to NICE/non-blocking (I9 no-operational-impact, E3 no-change -- the fresh compliance-officer instance's own words were 'at most LOW/advisory') -- unknown_plugin's no-audit-row posture matches its true same-phase siblings (containment_unreadable, generic-offline), both pre-existing and unaudited.
